text.en:
All technical personnel of the Bureau of Mines in the following category shall receive monthly
incentive allowances in accordance with the salary grouping herein below:
PositionsMonthly Incentive Allowance
Geologists(P6,888)
Paleontologists(P6,888)
Geophysicists(P6,888)
Mining Engineers(P6,888)
Metallurgists I(P6,888)
Senior Geologists(P8,400)
Senior Paleontologists(P8,400)
Metallurgists II(8,400)
Supervising Geologists I(P9,756)
Senior Mining Engineers(P9,756)
Senior Metallurgists(P9,756)
Supervising Geologists II(P11,328)

Supervising Mining Engineers(P13,152)
Supervising Metallurgists(P13,152)
Assistant Chief Geologist(P13,152)
Assistant Chief Mining Engineer(P13,152)
Assistant Chief Metallurgist(P13,152)
Mines Regional Officers(P15,264)
Chief Geologists(P15,264)
Chief Mining Engineer(P15,264)
Chief Petroleum Geologist(P15,264)
Chief Metallurgist(P15,264)
Assistant Director(P16,860)

The sum of Nine Hundred Thousand Pesos (P900,000) is hereby appropriated from the National
Treasury which may be taken from the unexpended appropriations or earnings in the Special Fund of the
Bureau of Mines. Thereafter, the said amount shall be included in the General Appropriations Decree of the
Bureau of Mines.
Done in the City of Manila, this 28th day of February, in the year of Our Lord, nineteen hundred and
seventy-four.
